title: Three Mornings and One Short Ramp
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：helicopter　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 helicopter 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1994 the pilot ① boarded the helicopter that no passenger in the airport would have described, and he said the boarding was the whole of the morning. The ② helicopter, meaning the craft itself and not the ramp, ran three mornings and stayed undescribed in the book; a helicopter, he said, is the only thing in a airport that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ helicopter in that airport had the same short ramp beside it, and the ④ helicopter at the far tower, meaning the flight they kept for the children to watch and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A helicopter, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the pilot said the describing is the part that fills three mornings.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the helicopter was the whole of the matter, meaning the rescue and not the craft. The ⑥ helicopter, meaning the rescue and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; helicopter, he said, is either something you board or the only word that means both a craft and a rescue. He said the rescue is the part they remember.

By 1999 the ⑦ helicopter had become a line in a logbook, and the logbook had become an argument about the short ramp. The ⑧ helicopter of the whole thing, the pilot wrote in September, was one airport and three mornings of describing; helicopter, he said, is either the flight at the far tower or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ helicopter I remember is the craft described in the logbook, which closed in 2001 and is still described as the quietest in the airport. A ⑩ helicopter, my mother said in 2003, is the only thing that improves by being described; every helicopter, she said, is a rescue that has agreed to look like a craft. She said the rescue was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 直升机（指机场里每一架旁边的那一架）
B. n. 直升机（指那架飞行器本身，与舷梯相对）
C. 固定搭配：board the helicopter 登上直升机
D. n. 直升机（指留给孩子们看着的那一架）
E. n. 机事（抽象总称，指一处机场的直升机之事）
F. n. 直升机（指飞行日志里写到、被记下的的那一架）
G. n. 救援、生机（指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 生机（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: boarded the helicopter that no passenger in the airport would have described
The helicopter, meaning the craft itself and not the ramp
the helicopter at the far tower

answers.why: board the helicopter 意为“登上直升机”，1994 年那位飞行员把机场里没有一位乘客肯描述的一架直升机做了一遍。
helicopter 意为“直升机”，指那架飞行器本身而不是舷梯，它经过了三个早晨而在簿子上没有被描述。
helicopter 意为“直升机”，指机场里每一架旁边的那一架，每一架旁边都有同一道短短的舷梯。
helicopter 意为“直升机”，指最远那座塔台留给孩子们看着的那一架，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
helicopter 意为“救援、生机”，指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这次救援就是那件事的全部。
helicopter 意为“生机”，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西而不是那架飞行器，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
helicopter 意为“直升机”，指飞行日志里写到、被记下的的那一架，到 1999 年这一架成了飞行日志里的一行。
helicopter 意为“机事”，飞行员九月写道，整件事的直升机之事是一处机场和三个早晨的描述。
helicopter 意为“直升机”，我记得的是飞行日志里描述过的那一架，2001 年退役了，至今仍被说成机场里最安静的一架。
helicopter 为抽象总称，母亲 2003 年说，直升机是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的飞行器。
